description: Universal Data & Asset Storage Policy for AGY. Enforces clear separation between Git source code, persistent databases, media files, secrets, and transient caches.

CLASS_G.name: Git Source Code
CLASS_G.description: Source code, scripts, configuration templates, documentation, and infrastructure manifests.
prohibited_items: Plaintext credentials and secrets (.env, id_rsa, tokens)

CLASS_D.name: Persistent Database
CLASS_D.description: SQLite databases, MariaDB dumps, PostgreSQL dumps, Redis snapshots.
CLASS_D.backup_mechanism: Consistent snapshot -> SHA256 -> rclone copy -> remote size probe

CLASS_M.name: Media Assets
CLASS_M.description: Rendered YouTube video files, exported audio, large graphical assets, packaged APKs.
CLASS_M.backup_mechanism: rclone copy with SHA256 catalog tracking

CLASS_S.name: Secret & Credential
CLASS_S.description: Private SSH keys, API tokens, database passwords, session cookies, OAuth tokens.
CLASS_S.default_destination: Local secure directory (0600) + Offline Key Vault
CLASS_S.backup_mechanism: Documented in BOOTSTRAP_CREDENTIALS.md with zero plaintext values

CLASS_T.name: Temporary & Cache
CLASS_T.description: node_modules, build directories, target/, logs, temporary scratch scripts.

canonical_layout.secrets: encrypted external vault only; never plaintext in GitHub or Drive
